name: bracket
units: SI: m, kg, s. Modal coordinates in m (each mode scaled to a largest nodal translation of 1).
frame: reference frame R = the frame of interface 1; every vector and tensor is in R

stress.unit: Pa per unit modal coordinate (per m of eta_k)
stress.recovery: C : sym(grad u) at the nodes of every cell, averaged over the cells of a node; the stress at a point is sum_k sigma_k eta_k (rigid motion gives none), von Mises of the summed components
stress.excluded: surface nodes tied to an interface (RBE2 spider) are never hotspots or peak candidates
